title: 3.0.0.1-dev-d crash / closes automatically when sliding between tabs and reach Combo pump tab
symptom: The app crashes and closes automatically when sliding between tabs and reaching the Combo pump tab. The crash occurred between 2:43 and 2:44 AM.
cause: An incorrect value was stored in the settings string for the 'Show comm. error count' preference, leading to an IllegalArgumentException when parsing the enum value.
fix: Set the 'Show comm. error count' setting to a valid value (e.g., 'Always' or 'on error'). The user selected 'Always' and the crash stopped. The maintainer suggested setting it to 'on error'.
evidence_quote: The fact is that none of the options was selected (was empty) now I choose "Always" and I have no crash... so far.
